headline: Approved minutes of the May 13th and June 10th, 2026 meetings; no other decisions recorded.
summary: The manager's update covered a new Facebook page for the commission and the annual action plan. The plan passed from the Legislative Council to committee, which will hold a special meeting to pass it before the August 16th deadline.
decisions: Approved the May 13th and June 10th, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Mike Johnson made a motion to approve May 13th and June 10th, 2026 minutes, seconded by Jaymiah Herring. All were in favor. Minutes unanimously approved.

decision_titles: Approval of May 13th and June 10th, 2026 minutes
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Community Development Citizens 
Advisory Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
6:30 PM, August 12, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 The Chairperson, Mr. Brian Courtney, called the meeting to order at 6:40pm. 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Present: Brain C. Courtney, Camile Samuels, Mike Johnson & Jaymiah Herring. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 Mike Johnson made a motion to approve May 13th and June 10th, 2026 minutes, 
seconded by Jaymaiah Herring. All were in favor. Minutes unanimously approved.  
  1. 
1. May 13th, 2026 
  
  
 
  2. 
1. June 10th,2026 
  
  
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No public comments. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 No Correspondence. 
6. COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT MANAGER'S UPDATE   
 Ms. Camile Samuels updated the board about the Facebook page opened for the 
Commission in the name of CDBG. She requested board members to follow the page for 
future updates. The annual action plan at the Legislative Council meeting passed to the 
committee. They are having a special meeting to pass our annual action plan. The 
deadline to pass the plan is August 16th. 
  
7. OLD BUSINESS   
 No old business. 
8. NEW BUSINESS
No new business. 
9. ADJOURNMENT   
 Jaymaiah Herring made a motion to adjourn the meeting by 6:50pm. Mike Johnson seconded. 
All in favor.  Motion passed.
